content.title: Service Inquiries
content.subtitle: Common questions regarding our process, materials, and timelines.

faqs.question: Do you actually provide one-hour service?
faqs.answer: Yes, our express processing can be completed in an hour for standard dry cleaning items dropped off before 2:00 PM. Highly specialized items or extensive stain treatments may require additional time.

faqs.question: Are your cleaning methods safe for sensitive skin?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We use environmentally conscious, hypoallergenic solvents that completely evaporate during the drying cycle, leaving zero harsh chemical residue or odor on your garments.

faqs.question: Can you clean leather and suede items?
faqs.answer: Leather and suede require a specialized conditioning process to maintain their texture and prevent cracking. We offer these services, but they take slightly longer than our standard textile processing.

faqs.question: Do you provide alterations and repairs?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer expert tailoring services ranging from simple hem adjustments to comprehensive garment restructuring. Turnaround times vary based on the complexity of the alteration.
